paragraphs: Rabbi Yitzhak of Kfar Akko said in the name of Rabbi Yohanan, as in [Avodah Zarah 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.7b.1) and [Bekhorot 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.31a.3).[^1]

notes.text: Both passages explicitly make Rabbi Yitzhak the transmitter and Rabbi Yohanan the authority for the ruling that follows.
